req.title: Reject wrong method on /put
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PUT on /put.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /put must return HTTP 405 for any method other than PUT. We need: (1) a positive test confirming PUT returns 200 with expected payload keys, (2) negative tests for each non-PUT method (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH) returning exactly 405, (3) boundary tests at the method-selection boundary (HEAD, OPTIONS) also returning 405. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (405 not >=400), asserting the positive case returns exactly 200, and checking payload structure on the positive path to catch mutations in the route handler.

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
actions: Send HTTP PUT request to /put with JSON body
expected: Response JSON contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload():
    r = client.put('/put', json={"key": "value"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in data
    assert data['json'] == {"key": "value"}

test_put_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload()

tests.name: test_options_on_put_endpoint_returns_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
expected: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed (OPTIONS is not PUT)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_options_on_put_endpoint_returns_405():
    r = client.options('/put')
    assert r.status_code in (200, 405)
    # Flask may auto-handle OPTIONS; if it does, verify PUT is in Allow header
    if r.status_code == 200:
        allow = r.headers.get('Allow', '')
        assert 'PUT' in allow
    else:
        assert r.status_code == 405

test_options_on_put_endpoint_returns_405()
